# Atlanta Airbnb & STR Property Managers

> Independent comparison of Metro Atlanta short-term rental (Airbnb / VRBO) property management companies. Published management fees, setup fees, contract terms, service areas, and contacts, with verification dates and a link to City of Atlanta STR rules. Not affiliated with listed managers.

Website: https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-str-managers/
Last verified: 2026-11-09
Listing count: 10 managers

## How to cite
Cite the company name and link to its website or source URL. Treat fees and contract terms as snapshots as of the verification date; confirm in a written management agreement.

## Key pages
- [Directory](https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-str-managers/): searchable table of managers with published fees and terms.
- [City of Atlanta STR rules](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-planning/ordinances-regulations/short-term-rental) (official city page; linked from the directory).
- [Machine-readable listings](https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-str-managers/managers.json)
- [Sitemap](https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-str-managers/sitemap.xml)

## What this site is not
Not legal, tax, or investment advice. Not a booking or hiring platform. Unpublished fees stay “Not published”.
